content: Vikram Singh from ProtectAll Agency called Riya Mukherjee to inform her that her health policy had expired on 15/09/2026. Riya was unaware and expressed disappointment. Vikram explained her options: renewing the current policy or switching to a newer plan with more coverage. Riya requested renewal information and a coverage summary, which Vikram agreed to email immediately.

action_items: Email summary of current coverage to customer
